question: If another effect lets me cast a split card with aftermath from my hand, can I cast the aftermath half?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if you cast it from any zone other than a graveyard, you cannot cast the half with aftermath.
expected.answer: If another effect allows you to cast a split card with aftermath from any zone other than a graveyard, you can’t cast the half with aftermath.
